T: Sent from the future. Hungry now.
D: A cyborg assassin is sent back from 2029 to kill Sarah Connor.
P: Serve the mains when the Terminator tells the desk sergeant he'll be back.
S: Thin fries fried twice, served with tomato sauce
Thin fries soaked, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted, served with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.
Corn chips with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, sour cream and salsa
Corn chips layered with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, sour cream and salsa.
Tiki Motel peanut butter cracker stacks

Buttery crackers sandwiched with whipped honey peanut butter, half dipped in dark chocolate and sprinkled with flaky salt, like a vending machine raid done right. Beat 150g smooth peanut butter with 2 tbsp honey and 30g soft butter until fluffy. Spread on 20 round butter crackers and top with another 20 to make sandwiches. Melt 150g dark chocolate. Dip each sandwich halfway into the chocolate, lay on baking paper and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 20 minutes until set.
M: Thick chuck cheeseburger with iceberg, tomato, onion and pickles
Thick chuck patty griddled to medium, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles on a toasted bun.
holed up at the Tiki Motel

Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in peppery spiced flour and fried crisp, served in a paper-lined bucket with hot sauce and pickles. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp pepper. Lift the chicken from the buttermilk, dredge well and rest 10 minutes. Fry in batches at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack and serve with hot sauce and pickles.
W: Lattice topped cherry pie with a sweet shortcrust base
Pitted cherries (fresh or frozen) with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre
Dark rum, lime and cola over ice with a dash of bitters

Dark rum over ice with a full lime squeezed in, topped with cold cola and finished with a dash of bitters, a proper eighties club drink. Cut 2 limes into quarters. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice and squeeze 2 lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in. Add 45ml dark rum to each glass and a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold cola and stir once.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak and dry up to 2 hours ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water.
Drain and dry very well.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 140C for the first cook until pale and soft, then lift out and rest.
Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp.
Salt straight away and serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

dishes.make_ahead: Best baked just before serving; have the beans, cheddar and toppings ready in the fridge up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Spread the chips over a tray.
Dot with the refried beans and scatter over the cheddar and jalapenos.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with sour cream and salsa and serve at once.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; season, griddle and build just before serving

steps.text: Shape the mince into four thick patties. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Season just before cooking and griddle on a hot surface to medium.
Lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

veg.n: Big Jeff's mushroom and haloumi burger
veg.make_ahead: Trim the mushrooms and prep the toppings up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; griddle and build just before serving

steps.text: Trim the mushroom stems. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season and griddle on a hot surface, pressing down, until tender.
Griddle the haloumi until golden, sit a slice on each mushroom, lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Toss the cherries with the sugar, lemon juice and cornflour.
Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets and fill with the cherries.
Cut the other two sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top.
Bake until deep golden and the filling bubbles. Cool a little before slicing.

s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries and soak for 30 minutes, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until golden. Salt straight away and serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

s.how: Spread a 300g bag of corn chips on a tray and dot with a tin of refried beans. Scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes and top with sour cream and a jar of salsa.

m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties, season just before cooking and griddle to medium. Melt cheddar on top under a lid. Build on toasted buns with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, onion and pickles.
